elements.name: Resize ribbon customization while a command is staged

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and ribbon customization is open with an empty Part Tools target
All Commands is shown in the available-command list
the user drags the lower-right dialog corner outward
the dialog and both command lists become wider and taller
the user adds 2D Sketches to the custom-panel target
the target shows 2D Sketches with Large and Text unchecked
the target selector indicates a pending change
the user drags the lower-right dialog corner inward
the dialog and both command lists become smaller
the staged 2D Sketches row and its unchecked options remain visible
the target selector still indicates a pending change
the dialog closes without applying the staged command

elements.name: Resize ribbon customization while a command is staged

steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory
